name: Lethean-Pingo
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past an exposed planetary core, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
